hints.title: Spacing Cooldown Interval
hints.text: Identical tasks must have at least space days between them, so if task was last executed on day d, it cannot be run before day d + space + 1.

hints.title: Timeline Advance
hints.text: For each task in order, advance the current day to max(current_day + 1, last_done[task] + space + 1).

hints.title: Last Executed Day Map
hints.text: Record the assigned day for the current task in a hash map before proceeding.

hints.title: Greedy Timeline Simulation Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass updating last executed timestamps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Stepping through empty days one by one causes O(n * space) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash map stores most recent execution day per distinct task.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Jumps directly to valid execution timestamps without iterative idle day simulation.
